narrative.overview: RepoLens is a type specimen for a codebase. Technology names are set at specimen scale; the index is the navigation; the evidence depth axis is the reader's hand. The system uses warm paper, ink, and one vermilion foundry accent, then withholds ornament so the letterforms and the data carry the page.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper, ink, and one vermilion accent.
Self-hosted display serif at specimen scale.
Left index rail and vertical report legs.
A real evidence-depth axis (name → role → modules).
Flat rules, no cards, no glass, no gradient text.

rules.name: The One Proof Mark Rule
rules.body: Vermilion is the proof mark: use it for the active leg, the live depth value, the primary action, and the selected state. Do not use it as a background wash.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Depth is a rule on paper. No drop shadows, no glass, no card elevation.

rules.name: The Depth Axis Rule
rules.body: The depth control is the only view mode. Its three named stops are NAME, ROLE, MODULES; do not replace it with a filter or a card toggle.

dos: Do keep the specimen display at 96px maximum and body at 11–13px.
Do use the depth axis as the only report view control.
Do keep vermilion for proof marks and active states only.
Do keep tech entries as rows with a 1px rule.
donts: Don't introduce cards, rounded containers, glass, glow, or gradient text.
Don't turn the depth axis into a filter or a hidden setting.
Don't set body copy in the display serif.
Don't add a second accent or a second display face.
Don't use the report index as a decorative sidebar with no controls.
